curve_initialized_with_low_offset.meaning: OffsetProgressiveCurve was initialized with an offset18 parameter below the report's low-offset threshold, leaving the stored OFFSET collapsed.

offset18.meaning: offset18 initialization parameter passed to initialize before the withdrawal.

user_has_deposit.meaning: The user holds an open deposit position in the curve whose full withdrawal is attempted.

withdrawal_reverts.meaning: The full-withdrawal execution reverts with PANIC(0x11) arithmetic underflow.

claims.scope: Full withdrawal of a user's deposited assets from OffsetProgressiveCurve

preconditions.text: OffsetProgressiveCurve was initialized with an offset18 parameter smaller than 1e9.; During initialize, OFFSET = PCMath.divDown(OFFSET18, 1e18) truncates to 0 because OFFSET18 < 1e18, so the stored OFFSET is 0 before the withdrawal.; The user has a deposit (open position) in the curve whose full withdrawal is attempted.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Users should be able to fully withdraw their deposited assets from OffsetProgressiveCurve without the withdrawal reverting and trapping funds (inferred from the claimed trapped-funds failure).
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The full withdrawal deterministically reverts with PANIC(0x11) arithmetic underflow.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: No state transition between initialize and the full withdrawal changes the stored OFFSET or other curve parameters.
The user's deposit is positive, so the attempted full withdrawal exercises the withdrawal conversion path.
SLOPE and the 1e18 scaling are fixed contract constants, not free variables.
Only the direct arithmetic-underflow revert is modeled; external calls and operator error are out of scope.

limitations: funds_trapped (permanent blockage / trapped funds) is a secondary consequence of the revert and is deferred, not part of the core V.
The offset18 threshold inconsistency (1e9 vs 1e18) is retained as a non-blocking clarification.
Exact deposit assets/shares are handled symbolically; no concrete amount is asserted.
No authorization or attacker model applies, so effect_requires_any_authorization is not used.
